result.headline: Output channel 3 (pitch-loop surface) froze at 1900 us at t=52.142 s; roll and yaw tracking degraded afterwards.
result.explanation: A control fault occurred at t=52.142 s: ch3, which serves the pitch loop, stopped following and sat at 1900 us to the end. Whether the fault is the channel, the mixer or the command source cannot be separated on this data.

evidence.quote: CONSTANT actuator.output[ch[3]] was varying, then held 1900 from t=52.142 s to the end of the recording (16.995 s, 53 samples)
evidence.shows: Output froze at 1900 us with no mode-change event to explain it.

evidence.quote: SHIFT actuator.output[ch[3]] changed level for good at t=52.142 s: median 1500 before, 1900 after us (100x its variation before)
evidence.shows: Largest step in the recording, a 400 us jump in one sample.

evidence.quote: ROLE actuator.output[ch[3]] follows control.attitude_setpoint[pitch] (correlation 0.7 over the recording): it serves that loop
evidence.shows: The frozen output belongs to the pitch loop. The pitch setpoint then moved from about -2.4 to +6.8 deg while ch3 stayed at 1900.

evidence.quote: SHIFT vehicle.attitude[yaw] followed its setpoint worse for good from t=50.851 s: typical |error| 5.575 before, 42.2 after deg (11.7x its variation before)
evidence.shows: Yaw tracking degraded for good, starting about 1.3 s before the hold, so it is not simply an effect of the hold.

evidence.quote: SHIFT vehicle.attitude[roll] followed its setpoint worse for good from t=50.052 s: typical |error| 1.514 before, 7.087 after deg (5.7x its variation before)
evidence.shows: Roll tracking degraded from the onset window. Roll error rose from 0.693 to 16.856 deg across the hold.

checked.check: Sequence of departures from baseline, 49-53 s
checked.result: vehicle.attitude[pitch] left baseline at 50.478 s, ch3/4/5 slightly at 50.705 s, then roll attitude at 52.257 s and yaw at 52.608 s. The ch3 jump to 1900 is at 52.142 s.

checked.check: Compare before and after the ch3 hold at t=52.142 s
checked.result: ch3 is flagged frozen (1498 -> 1900 us, spread 2 -> 0). ch4 and ch5 fall from 1496 to 1325 us as the roll setpoint goes to -34 deg. Roll tracking error ratio is 24x; pitch tracking ratio is only 1.18.
Only two start-up events at t=1.015 s (Battery low voltage warning and Sensor helth error). Nothing at the time of the hold.

effects.quote: TRACKING vehicle.attitude[roll] diverged from its setpoint from t=51.576 to 57.763 s (peak |error| 25.193 deg)
effects.why: Roll diverged after the ch3 hold. ch4 and ch5 were responding to the roll setpoint while ch3 was stuck, so this is probably a consequence.

effects.quote: TRACKING vehicle.attitude[yaw] diverged from its setpoint from t=50.851 to 60.805 s (peak |error| 50.087 deg)
effects.why: Yaw error followed a yaw setpoint step at 44 s and the loss of control authority. It started before the hold, so it is only partly an effect.

effects.quote: ANOMALY a12 t=63.384 s: vehicle.altitude[relative] changed level for good (49.939 -> 64.695 m) (see line 43; strength 2.673)
effects.why: Altitude change 11 s after the hold, a flight-path consequence.

next_action.action: Inspect the ch3 servo, linkage and wiring, and read the raw flight-controller ch3 command log.
next_action.why: Separates a stuck servo or output path from a controller or mixer command that itself went to 1900 us, which this recording cannot show.
how: Read the controller's own logged ch3 command (not the output readback) around t=45-53 s.
Bench-test ch3 with a servo tester or a manual sweep; check connector, power rail and horn for binding.
Check whether the mixer or failsafe configuration can force 1900 us on ch3.
next_action.conditions: Aircraft on the ground, props off or motor disarmed, battery connected. Bench check only, no flight.
next_action.baseline: The ch3 trace before t=52.142 s, where it varied around 1500 us and followed the pitch setpoint.

outcomes.label: Controller command also pinned at 1900
outcomes.means: The fault is upstream of the output stage: mixer, controller or command source.
outcomes.then: Search the controller log for the mode or saturation trigger.

outcomes.label: Command moves, but servo or output sticks
outcomes.means: The fault is in the channel, servo or wiring.
outcomes.then: Isolate servo, harness and output driver.

outcomes.label: Bench sweep normal, command log unavailable
outcomes.means: The fault is intermittent or command-side.
outcomes.then: Request the controller's full log for the flight.

unknowns: Whether the controller commanded 1900 us or the output stage failed; the recording only holds the output value.
Why yaw tracking degraded from about 50.9 s, before the hold.
Whether the hold was a failsafe or a saturation the controller could not recover from.

data_requests.why_needed: Shows whether the 1900 us was commanded or an output failure.

unobservable.fact: Physical state of the ch3 servo, linkage and connector
unobservable.why_it_matters: Decides whether the actuator hardware is the fault.
unobservable.how_to_observe: Bench sweep of ch3 and visual and continuity check of the harness.

hypotheses.claim: Ch3 servo, wiring or output driver stuck at 1900 us, losing pitch-loop authority.
hypotheses.because: Only output that froze at its onset with no event. The recording observes the commanded output, not the servo.

hypotheses.claim: Controller or mixer commanded 1900 us on ch3, for example by saturation or a failsafe, and held it.
hypotheses.because: The output reads the same as a commanded value. Nothing in the data separates it from a stuck output.

hypotheses.claim: The yaw setpoint step and the roll setpoint swing to -40 deg drove the aircraft into a saturated state.
hypotheses.because: Yaw error started at 50.851 s, before the hold, and the roll setpoint dropped from 52.372 s. These may have pushed ch3 to its limit.

hypotheses.claim: Attitude estimate or sensor fault caused the tracking errors.
hypotheses.because: The step in one output with no matching estimate event fits an actuator or controller fault better. The 'Sensor helth' error is at start-up only.

events.what: ch3 held at 1900 us from 52.142 s
events.why: Frozen output on the pitch loop with no mode change.

events.what: ch4 and ch5 shifted to 1386 us
events.why: Roll pair responding to a -40 deg roll setpoint; may be a reaction.

events.what: Yaw tracking error 5.6 -> 42 deg from 50.851 s
events.why: Began before the hold, after a yaw setpoint step.

events.what: Roll tracking degraded from about 51.6 s
Start-up battery and sensor warnings at t=1.015 s
events.why: Start-up lines, nothing changed later that points back to them.

result.lesson: No earlier cases in the workspace; nothing to reuse.
result.reuse_when: A pitch-loop output channel freezes at a limit with no mode event, and the other loops carry on but track worse afterwards.
